summary: Tested the new 'confirm password' field on app/auth.tsx (register mode only) and app/forgot-password.tsx (reset-password step) via Playwright on web preview (mobile viewport 390x844). All requested scenarios PASS: confirm-password field shows only in REGISTER mode and disappears in LOGIN mode; mismatched passwords show 'Hasła nie są identyczne.' error without calling the API (verified no navigation on mismatch); matching passwords allow successful registration/reset; eye-toggle show/hide works correctly on all fields (auth-password, auth-confirm-password, and shared toggle on forgot-password's new/confirm fields - toggling either eye icon reveals/hides BOTH fields together as designed); full regression confirmed: login with freshly reset password succeeds, and login with existing seeded user ania_t1@test.pl/test123 (single password field, no confirm field) works with no regression.
action_items: No action needed - confirm password feature verified working correctly on both auth.tsx and forgot-password.tsx, no regressions found.
critical_code_review_comments: auth.tsx: confirmPassword field correctly rendered only when mode === 'register' (conditional block at line 124-138), and submit() validates password !== confirmPassword before calling register(), preventing unnecessary API calls on mismatch - confirmed via no navigation/account creation on mismatch submit.

forgot-password.tsx: single shared revealPassword state correctly drives secureTextEntry for both new-password and confirm-password inputs - confirmed toggling either eye icon (new or confirm) changes BOTH fields' visibility simultaneously, matches spec.
resetPassword() validates newPassword !== confirmPassword before calling /auth/reset-password API - confirmed no API call/navigation occurs on mismatch (stayed on reset screen with error shown).
Both confirm-password fields in auth.tsx and forgot-password.tsx use textContentType='newPassword' consistently with the main password fields - good iOS/Android autofill consistency.

rca_of_issue: No bugs found. Step-by-step verification: (1) Register tab shows confirm-password field (testID auth-confirm-password-input), Login tab does not - confirmed via is_visible checks on both tabs. (2) Submitted register with password='testpass2026' vs confirm='testpass2026DIFFERENT' -> error 'Hasła nie są identyczne.' shown, stayed on auth screen (no account created, no navigation). (3) Toggled auth-password-input-toggle-visibility and auth-confirm-password-input-toggle-visibility independently -> each correctly toggles its own field's type attribute (password <-> text) while preserving the typed value exactly. (4) Fixed confirm-password to match -> submit succeeded, navigated to /quiz (new registration flow). (5) On forgot-password, requested code for the new test user, grabbed code from backend logs, entered new-password='newTestPass2026' + confirm='newTestPass2026MISMATCH' -> error 'Hasła nie są identyczne.' shown, stayed on reset screen. (6) Toggled reset-password-new-password-toggle-visibility -> BOTH new and confirm password input 'type' attributes changed together (password->text), confirming shared toggle state; toggled back via the confirm field's own eye icon -> both reverted together too. Values preserved throughout. (7) Fixed confirm field to match -> submit succeeded, auto-logged in, navigated to /quiz. (8) Logged out (cleared localStorage + IndexedDB), logged back in with the new password qa_confirmpw_1793551092@test.pl/newTestPass2026 -> success, landed on /quiz with no auth-error. (9) Logged out again, logged in with existing seeded user ania_t1@test.pl/test123 -> success, landed on home '/' with existing profile/premium-upsell modal visible as expected, no auth-error, confirming single-password-field LOGIN flow has no regression.
